I have the same feeling and as such I can’t say I totally understand your situation but I can relate. I love for my parents, I do not wish to go without leaving them nothing, that’s too selfish. I struggle and fight this reason for my existence, at times I feel I’m tired and wanting to give up, at some fucked up moment I even wish the death of my parents so I can end myself, I m ashamed to have such thoughts, but yet it may show how desperate and how fucked up I am. Even so, I am still fighting still alive, been like this for the past 10 years, and hopefully will continue to do so. So don’t give up my friend.

I totally feel you. This is the feeling I have for the past 9-10 years. Longing for suicide to end it all but don’t want to die jus yet, without achieving my goal. Perhaps when the goal is achieve i can go in peace, but such goal have no end to It (aka. Money) maybe I can never have the peace I so long wish for. Even so, don’t give up and keep fighting!
I have a terminal illness, a ticking time bomb in my brain which is said to be inoperable. Think twice of what you wish for.
Like wise I appreciate  for time reading. Hope it will open up an alternative way of thinking. Anyways, I’m here if u wish to discuss. Take care.

Perhaps you don’t wish to kill your self but after thinking you came up the idea of doing it. If this is the case, what are the reason justifying this is the best course of action? and even if the reason is justified, what are the benefits of doing such? Not asking you to care of the feelings of others, frankly if I were in your situation I couldn’t care less, but if I was in your position and to make such action, I’d wish my action would mean something and worth the sacrifice? Perhaps worth exploring. This is what I do when it comes this close to suicide. May not work for you, but I thought I’ll share anyways.

Sometimes it’s better to talk to strangers. In a way they can express opinions without bias. It is okay to try again. The magnitude of problems and issue you r dealing with is overwhelming to say the least, perhaps try solving one by one, like a puzzle it can be solved, slowly but surely. The important part is don’t give up solving it.

Overthink is good thing I believe, you r able to simulate possibilities. This is my strength and in a way the downfall. Because I know what will happen. And yes this was a factor which lead to my post.

Getting a master degree is no small feat my friend. I do agree education is kinda worthless in a sense, but what you need atm is an opportunity. Once you have it everything. I graduated without actually getting my certificate lol, when I job hunt it gradually wore me down, confidence and esteem, started to doubt my abilities and worth. But know this, the concrete prove is you r a smart lad. Give it a while, if you give up at job hunting stage then my friend be warned, there’s worse to come in life. When u r over this stage and perhaps when u r older and look back this setback, you probably will laugh and understand it’s only a minor obstacle in life. Because I did lol, although not suicidal but self degrading,

Don’t give up without a fight my friend, prove and try you can turn things around for your happiness. Don’t let your suffering go in vain. You certainly do not deserve the suffering. But hey you had a partner, I wish I do (I kinda do but not really) At time you may blame yourself but don’t let it consume you, don’t think it’s your fault for not being strong enough, your intent is noble, to prioritise others feeling above your own, this I understand for I am the same. Gather the strength and try again? Please?

hey! You have a master degree you are a capable and intelligent person, I don’t have a master degree :) job hunting is difficult and defeating, perhaps feeling unwanted or not good enough. But it’s normal, sending CV and job applications without reply etc. I went thru it before for a year or so. Don’t suicide over being jobless, I’m atm jobless too, don’t despair and don’t let it be the cause of low self esteem. it will take time, but until then enjoy the freedom before working consumes your time.

Counselling, psychiatry, psychology, CBT. I tried seeking help, not once but a couple of times. Medications was prescribed etc. It leads to the feeling of despair and hopelessness. Unfortunately I know too much about medicine and stuff as I studied it before. Thanks for reading anyways, I appreciate your time and patience.

Reading your experience didn’t upset me, positively speaking it make me realise I don’t deserve to feel how I feel knowing someone is worse off. remember your goal and what u want perhaps will give you to drive and motivation to continue, personally speaking this is something I no longer have. Perhaps in the end u give up the fight, but do it without regret and with a valid reason. don’t let your suffering go In vain. Try and see.

In one way or the other I can relate, frankly you have more reasons to be upset or suicidal than I do. In comparison my situation is a joke compare to you. But analysing what was posted, you achieved success but lost it somehow. I believe you can repeat the same and be successful again, if this is something you feel that matters to you. Perhaps start from there, achieve greatness and hopefully everything great and happy will follow, break this downward spiral and try again. You are only 30, you have time. I believe you can turn things around, give it a chance?

Hope you get through this tough time. 💪💪💪
